desc: Handle N ≤ 60: use A=2, M=2^N-1 (if N odd) or A=2, M=2^{N/2}+1 (if N even)
Handle N > 60: search for prime p = k*N+1 (k starting from 1, increasing) with p ≤ 1e18, such that ord_p(2) = N, then output A=2, M=p
Implement Miller-Rabin primality test for numbers up to 1e18
Implement order computation: given prime p and A=2, compute the order of 2 mod p by factoring N and checking p divides 2^{N/q} - 1 for prime factors q
Ensure the search bound is sufficient (try k up to at least 1e6 or until p > 1e18)
Test with sample input and verify all test cases produce valid output
Handle potential edge case where no prime is found within the loop (fallback to 2^{60}-1 or another construction)
